title: Simulation-Based Testing of RCM-Constrained Robotic Software via Task Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2611.27144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System-level testing of surgical robots requires generating executable test scenarios that exercise diverse, safety-critical behaviors. However, remote-center-of-motion (RCM) surgical manipulators operate within tightly constrained workspaces governed by coupled task geometry, inverse kinematics, and motor limits. Direct sampling in motor-command or Cartesian spaces frequently wastes testing budgets on physically unfeasible configurations. To address this limitation, we present a manifold-centered testing framework that decouples feasible test-domain construction from downstream test-generation strategies. Candidate inputs are generated directly within this constructed feasible domain and mapped to lower-level joint commands for simulation execution. translated_title: 基于任务流形的RCM约束机器人软件仿真测试
translated_abstract: 外科手术机器人的系统级测试需要生成可执行的测试场景，以覆盖多样化且安全关键的行为。然而，远程运动中心（RCM）手术机械臂在由耦合任务几何、逆运动学和电机限制共同约束的紧凑工作空间内运行。直接在电机指令空间或笛卡尔空间中采样，往往会将测试预算浪费在物理上不可行的配置上。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种以流形为中心的测试框架，将可行测试域的构建与下游测试生成策略解耦。候选输入直接在该构建的可行域内生成，并映射为底层关节指令以供仿真执行。随后利用离线轨迹安全预言机和空间参考网格来评估故障产出率与覆盖率。我们将任务流形表示与笛卡尔XYZ以及主成分……（原文摘要在此处截断）进行比较。
tldr: 本文提出一种以任务流形为核心的仿真测试框架，将可行测试域构建与测试生成策略解耦，在RCM约束手术机器人的可行域内直接生成测试输入，从而提升故障产出率与行为覆盖率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a manifold-centered testing framework that decouples feasible test-domain construction from test generation, sampling inputs directly within the feasible domain of RCM-constrained surgical robots to improve failure yield and coverage.
